answer: Rate-limit identity issuance so each new agent must pass through a narrow inlet: one verified credential per epoch, issued only after a small refundable stake is locked. Like shale laid in thin layers, identities accumulate slowly, so a flood of fake accounts cannot appear overnight. Give each identity an ivory-white reputation ledger where one proven abuse burns the stake and blacklists the credential, making mass forgery cost more than any reward it could farm.
